#### Logistic Regression Revisited

Helen Zhao made a method for speeding up logistic regression with penalty. However is is computationally challenging to do log-reg in high dimension. Screening Method for Interaction Terms.

For Ridge Logistic Regression it is useful for selecting or simultaneously shrinking correlated predictors. in the $p > n \text{ or } p < n$ case. 

Logistic Regression may be the best predictive model for two class classification tasks.

For 3+ class classification you still declare a base class and compute the probabilities based on that base class.
With multi-class regression you simply get probabilities for each class, then you pick the assigned class based on which ever has the highest probability.


#### Multiclass Bayes... > 2 classes.
multiclass you move from Bernoulli -> multinomial distribution.
